name: windows-pwsh
description: Curated MIT rule pack preventing recurring POSIX-shell pitfalls on Windows PowerShell (pwsh).

rules.title: PowerShell rejects POSIX heredocs (<< EOF)
rules.error_template: ParserError: The '<' operator is reserved for future use in PowerShell
rules.fix_summary: PowerShell does not support POSIX heredocs (<< 'EOF'). Pass inline scripts via `python -c`, `node -e`, or a PowerShell here-string `@' ... '@ | Set-Content`.

rules.title: Use $env:VAR instead of POSIX export in PowerShell
rules.error_template: The term 'export' is not recognized as a name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or executable program
rules.fix_summary: In PowerShell set environment variables with `$env:KEY='value'` instead of POSIX `export KEY=value`.

rules.title: rm -rf fails on PowerShell Remove-Item alias
rules.error_template: Remove-Item: A parameter cannot be found that matches parameter name 'rf'
rules.fix_summary: In PowerShell `rm` aliases `Remove-Item` and rejects `-rf`. Use `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force <path>`.
